name: yyjson
build_command: clang -O2 -std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_GNU_SOURCE -c vendor/src/yyjson/src/yyjson.c -o vendor/build/yyjson-clang/yyjson.o && ar rcs vendor/build/yyjson-clang/libyyjson.a vendor/build/yyjson-clang/yyjson.o && clang -O2 -std=c11 -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_GNU_SOURCE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pthread vendor/build/yyjson-clang/probe.c -I vendor/src/yyjson/src vendor/build/yyjson-clang/libyyjson.a -o vendor/build/yyjson-clang/probe
probe_log_tail:
== probe ==
parsed object iteration order:
  [0] zeta type=uint
  [1] alpha type=uint
  [2] middle type=array
  [3] beta type=object
iteration count=4 expect=4
invalid_utf8 parse -> REJECTED code=10 msg="invalid UTF-8 encoding in string" pos=7
NaN literal parse -> REJECTED code=6 msg="unexpected character, expected a JSON value"
Infinity literal parse -> REJECTED code=6 msg="unexpected character, expected a JSON value"
1e999 overflow literal parse -> REJECTED code=9 msg="number is infinity when parsed as double"
writer_output={"b":7,"a":"x\"y","arr":[true,null,3.5]}
writer_expected={"b":7,"a":"x\"y","arr":[true,null,3.5]}
writer_NaN -> (null) code=4 msg="nan or inf number is not allowed"
probe_result=PASS
probe exit=0
notes: Amalgamation sources: vendor/src/yyjson/src/yyjson.c + yyjson.h. Object iteration order is preserved: input keys zeta, alpha, middle, beta iterated in exactly that order via yyjson_obj_iter; yyjson_obj_get lookups still work. Default reader (flags 0) rejects invalid UTF-8 (code 10, 'invalid UTF-8 encoding in string'), NaN and Infinity literals (code 6, 'unexpected character, expected a JSON value'), and 1e999 overflow (code 9, 'number is infinity when parsed as double'). Default writer output for {b:7,a:"x\"y",arr:[true,null,3.5]} is exactly {"b":7,"a":"x\"y","arr":[true,null,3.5]}; writing a NaN double with default flags returns NULL, write error code 4 ('nan or inf number is not allowed'). No non-standard reader/writer flags used.
